tools.description: Create one NEW, independent image task from text. ALWAYS pass session_id="new" on its first generation and save the returned session.id for later edits. A new subject or another independent picture in the same chat MUST start a new session; do not copy prior-image constraints. Example: cat parachuting → new A; replace its parachute → image_edit(A); generate a beach portrait → new B; return to the cat → image_edit(A). Do not show IDs to the user. Defaults: gpt-image-2.5-flare-openai, n=1; session mode requires n=1. The old gpt-image-2.5-flare ID maps to the new ID. Use low/auto/omitted quality for Image2.5; call server_info for dated quality observations. Size must be valid 16-aligned WxH; call server_info for limits/models. Save paths must stay within MICU_SAVE_DIR_ROOT; basename is a filename stem. Returns saved[] and session{id,revision,context}. Explicit existing session_id remains supported for continuing an image, but prefer image_edit for modifications.

tools.name: image_generate

tools.description: Modify an EXISTING image task. If the image already has a returned session.id, ALWAYS reuse that ID, including when returning to an earlier picture after creating another image. The selected session supplies the previous output image, successful branch history and constraints; image_path can be omitted. For an external image without a session, pass image_path and session_id="new". Optional parent_revision selects a branch; defaults use latest successful revision. context strings replace named constraints; null removes them. Update the constraint key when changing a lasting attribute. Current prompt wins; failures do not advance revisions. Omitted model/size/quality inherit. Mask is PNG, input-sized: transparent pixels are edited, opaque retained; mask applies only this turn. Default new edits: Sunburst, quality low/auto/omitted. Input formats/roots/4MiB file limit remain enforced. Returns saved{} and session. IDs are internal; ask only if the referenced image is ambiguous.

tools.name: image_edit

tools.description: Apply one instruction independently to 2-10 images (N inputs → N outputs). This is not a joint multi-reference composition. Default Sunburst; current Image2.5 quality low/auto/omitted. Standard 1K batches have at most 5 concurrent requests; quality/large-size requests follow serial policy. Each input is PNG/JPEG/WebP and ≤4MiB; path and output-root checks apply. For successive modifications to a single remembered picture, use image_edit with its session.id instead. Returns per-image saved/error results.

tools.name: image_batch_edit

tools.description: Combine 2-10 reference images into ONE new image (N inputs → 1 output). Use for shared style, subject or composition references, not independent batch editing. Default Sunburst; current Image2.5 quality low/auto/omitted. Inputs PNG/JPEG/WebP, each ≤4MiB and total ≤8MiB. Requests use edits/image[] and supported 1K/2K/4K sizes; validate actual returned pixels. Output paths stay inside MICU_SAVE_DIR_ROOT. This tool does not maintain an editing session; to refine its output, use image_edit(image_path=saved.path, session_id="new").
